## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change makes possible.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. For Windows/device work, include versions and distinguish offline, virtual-fixture and physical tests. State what remains untested.

## Scope and compatibility

Note relevant API, licence, dependency or installation implications. Keep unrelated changes and generated artifacts out of the PR. Do not include credentials, customer keys, private signing material or full memory dumps.
